transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Honestly, I'm mainly here because HR at work and... well, my sister, they keep saying I've gotten too thin. 

I don't really see the issue myself. From my side, I just notice that my suits fit a lot sharper now. My weight has kept dropping since my divorce, and I guess they're just making a big deal out of it and wanted me to come in.
Do you find yourself actively restricting the amount or types of food you eat in order to keep your weight low?

Yeah, I suppose I do. Most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning, and then maybe a protein bar between sales calls. At night, I'll have something small, like some grilled chicken, but definitely without the rice or anything like that. 

It's just... I feel like once I sit down and start eating a full meal, it feels like I completely messed up the whole day. So keeping it strict like that just makes more sense to me.
Do you ever find yourself eating an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time, and feel like you've lost control over that eating?

No, not really. I don't do that. Like I said, I keep things pretty strict. I don't ever just... sit down and eat a huge amount of food or feel out of control like that. If anything, it's the exact opposite for me.
When you look in the mirror, do you feel that your body weight or shape is a problem, or that you are perhaps still heavier than you would like to be?

Yeah, I do. When I look in the mirror, especially right before a big meeting or if I'm getting ready for a date, I... I tend to just zero right in on my stomach and my face. 

If I look in the mirror and think I look soft at all, it really bothers me. I just feel like if I have extra weight there, people are going to look at me and see someone who is sloppy or weak. In my line of work, you really can't afford to look like you don't have it together. So yeah, I definitely still see areas that are a problem for me.
Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle since you began losing weight?
Uh, well, I'm a guy, so I don't have a menstrual cycle. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you noticed any issues with feeling constantly cold, or perhaps feeling lightheaded or faint when you stand up?

I mean, yeah, I do get cold pretty easily now. I usually have to keep a sweater or a jacket nearby, even if it's not that cold out. And... sometimes I get a little dizzy if I stand up too fast from my desk, but I just figure that's from sitting for too long or maybe needing some water. It's not a big deal.
Do you engage in any specific physical activities or exercise routines to help manage your weight or burn off the calories you've consumed?
No, not really. I mean, I don't go to the gym or run or anything like that. My job keeps me pretty busy, so I just focus on what I eat to manage things. I don't have a specific workout routine.
Could you tell me how much you currently weigh and what your height is?

I'm about 5'10", and last time I checked, I weigh around 125 pounds. Honestly, I'm only here because HR at work and my sister keep saying I've gotten way too thin. But from my side... I just see that my suits fit a lot sharper now. My weight has just kept dropping since my divorce, and I think it looks fine.
